verdict.rationale: Calendly's documented AI features are about booking meetings with other people: Callie coordinates meetings over email, and the MCP server and Scheduling API book meetings on request. Nothing in the pack shows AI placing a user's own tasks into calendar blocks around meetings and deadlines, or re-planning them automatically when things change. Its 'reschedule request' is a manual action that lets invitees pick a new meeting time, which is a different capability from task time-blocking.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, AI schedules my tasks into real calendar blocks around meetings and deadlines, and re-plans automatically when things change
